name: comp-188
title: Switch With Brand Logo
blurb: Switch card with brand logo and description.
description: Switch in a card layout with brand logo, label, sublabel, and description. Built on shadcn's Switch.
use_when: Integration or service enablement in settings where logo identifies which service is being toggled.
avoid_when: Simple toggles or when space is constrained.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with aria-describedby for description. SVG logo marked aria-hidden.
